text.p: Pakistan Food & Agriculture Ministry said on Tuesday it bought 270,000 tonnes of wheat from the U.S. and Australian suppliers for shipment by January 31.
The ministry tendered for soft white wheat on December 9 and had received about 10 bids by Sunday.
"We have accepted the bids of three U.S. firms for 180,000 tonnes and one bid of an Australian company for the supply of 90,000 tonnes of wheat," a ministry official said.
He said the U.S. firms Cargil Inc, United Grain Corp and Harvest States will supply wheat at prices ranging from $152.97 to $154.43 a tonne FOB, while Cidic Australian Food at $160.365 a tonne.
